1 (Currently Amended): A method of cementing comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a carboxylated inulin processed from chicory; and allowing the cement composition to set.

2 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a thickening time of from about 2 hours to about 11 hours at temperatures up to about 280 *F.

3 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein a viscosity of the cement composition is about constant for a period of time after the cement composition is placed.

4 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein a suspension aid is not added to the cement composition.

5 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition has a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of the cement composition.

6 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin is derived from an inulin having an average molecular weight of about 500 or higher.

7 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the carboxylated inulin comprises carboxymethylated inulin.

8 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 7 wherein the carboxymethylated inulin has a degree of substitution by carboxymethylated of from about 0.1 to about 0.3.

9 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt. % of carboxylated inulin.

10 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition further comprises borate salts, an organic acid comprising an alpha-hydroxycarboxylic acid, a synthetic polymer comprising a carboxylate group, or any combination thereof.

11 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a subterranean formation that is a wellbore.

12 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 1 wherein the cement composition is placed in a wellbore.

13 (Currently Amended): A method of cementing in a subterranean formation comprising: providing a cement composition comprising a carboxylated inulin processed from chicory; placing the cement composition in the subterranean formation; and allowing the cement composition to set therein.

14 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition has a thickening time of from about 2 hours to about 11 hours at temperatures up to about 280 *F.

15 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 13 wherein a viscosity of the cement composition is about constant for a period of time after the cement composition is placed.

16 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 13 wherein a suspension aid is not added to the cement composition.

17 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition has a free water separation of from about 0.0 to about 2 wt.% of the cement composition.

18 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 13 wherein the carboxylated inulin is derived from an inulin having an average molecular weight of about 500 or higher.

19 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 13 wherein the carboxylated inulin comprises carboxymethylated inulin.

20 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 19 wherein the carboxymethylated inulin has a degree of substitution by carboxymethylated of from about 0.1 to about 0.3.

21 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition comprises from about 0.1 to about 5 wt. % of carboxylated inulin.

22 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition further comprises borate salts, an organic acid comprising an alpha-hydroxycarboxylic acid, a synthetic polymer comprising a carboxylate group, or any combination thereof.

23 (Currently Amended): The method of claim 13 wherein the cement composition is placed in a wellbore.
